reviews.review: Protective resolve reads clearly; tenderness is less visible. Rounded shelter anatomy, not a mouse.
Mischief reads strongly, but can lean sinister. The broken crescent needs originality review against other moon-shaped characters.
Composed gaze is readable. Long neck and belly runner still suggest a seal; revise that resemblance before approval.
Scattered attention slots avoid a reused face. Warm curiosity is subtle; may read as a living plant rather than a companion.
Distinct canopy and hanging core. Gaze is tiny at card size; contemplative wonder may be lost.
Guarded affection is among the clearest expressions. Keep softness rather than letting the folded face become an angry V.
Strong three-wall silhouette, weak emotional specificity. Needs more living intent; currently sculpture-like.
Distinct sweeping crest. Poise is visible, but anticipation can read aloof; no feline anatomy intended.
Different listening anatomy, but delight is not clear enough. Needs expressive membrane tension or motion.
Open scaffold and lifted support communicate hesitation. Cautious optimism needs a clearer living response.
